title: Onukrom — order, delivery & collection app for distributors in Bangladesh
metaDescription: Replace paper memos and phone calls. Sales reps take orders on an Android app, delivery men confirm delivery and cash, and you see sales, dues and stock live. 14 days free.
announce: Free 14-day trial + free setup help for distributors — get a demo
whatsappText: Hello Onukrom, I am a distributor and want to know more about the app.
eyebrow: For FMCG distributors & dealers in Bangladesh
headline: Know today what your team sold, delivered and collected
subline: No more paper memos and phone calls. Sales reps take orders on an Android app at the shop, delivery men confirm delivery and cash, and you see every order, taka and carton live from the office.

shots.dashboard: Today’s sales, collections and dues on one screen
shots.orders: Orders from the field, ready to approve

rolesTitle: Made for everyone in a distribution business

pains.title: Distribution runs on trust — and paper loses money
pains.text: If any of these happen in your business, Onukrom was built for you.

memo.problem: Order memos get lost or typed twice
memo.cost: Wrong items go out, shops complain, orders are missed.
memo.fix: the SR enters the order once, at the shop; it reaches the office in seconds.

visit.problem: “I visited the shop” — but did they?
visit.cost: Planned routes are skipped and you only find out from falling sales.
visit.fix: every order and visit carries GPS; fake or far-away locations are flagged.

cash.problem: Cash stays with the delivery man for days
cash.cost: Nobody knows exactly how much was collected, or from whom.
cash.fix: each payment is recorded at the shop; you confirm the deposit when it is handed in.

stock.problem: Dues and stock are only known at month-end
stock.cost: Credit runs over limits and fast-selling items run out.
stock.fix: dues per shop and stock per godown update with every order and delivery.

form.heading: See Onukrom with your own products and routes
form.text: Leave your number. We call you, show how it works for your business, and help you set up — free.

benefits.call: A call back within one working day
benefits.setup: Help entering your products, shops and routes
benefits.train: Your sales reps and delivery men shown the app
benefits.trial: 14 days free — pay only if it works for you

form.title: Get your free demo
form.name: Your name
form.submit: Call me for a free demo

form.thanksText: We will call you on {{phone}} soon. Keep your phone near you.

panel.title: Run the whole day from one screen
panel.text: Orders arrive the moment the SR takes them. Approve, load the van, collect — no calls, no paper.

approve.title: Approve in seconds
approve.text: See the shop, items, GPS check and credit limit before you say yes.

deliver.title: Plan every trip
deliver.text: Load approved orders onto a delivery man’s trip and follow it live.

collect.title: Count every taka
collect.text: Cash, bKash, Nagad and bank — collected, deposited, confirmed.

field.title: Simple enough for every SR and delivery man
field.text: Big buttons, Bangla first, works on low-cost Android phones and without internet.

order.title: An order in a minute
order.text: Cartons and pieces, the right price for each shop.

shops.title: Find or add the shop
shops.text: Nearest shops first; new shops saved with GPS.

trip.title: Deliver and collect
trip.text: Delivered, partial or failed — and the cash taken.

offline.title: No network? No problem
offline.text: Saved on the phone; pull down to send it all.

home.title: The day at a glance
home.text: Today’s orders, sales and deliveries left.

charts.title: Charts that answer questions
charts.text: Sales trend, sales by SR and route, collections by method.

pdf.title: PDF and Excel in one click
pdf.text: Print any report for the owner or the company — Bangla prints correctly.

dues.title: Dues by age
dues.text: Which shops owe, and how long since their last order.

grid.title: Everything a distributor needs, in one place
grid.text: No add-ons, no extra apps. Every plan has every feature.

collections.title: Collections & deposits

deliveries.title: Trips & deliveries

stock.title: Stock in every godown

gps.title: Every order checked against the shop’s location
gps.text: Orders taken far from the shop, with a fake-GPS app or a weak signal are flagged for the office — so you can trust what comes in.

control.title: Built for owners who want control

gps.text: Location checks the office can see.

company.title: Free demo call
company.text: We understand your business and create your company.

setup.title: Routes, products, staff
setup.text: A guide shows every step; import your shop list in one go.

orders.title: Your team starts
orders.text: SRs and delivery men install the app and log in with their phone number.

pricing.title: One clear monthly price
pricing.text: Every plan has every feature. 14 days free, then pay by bKash, Nagad or bank.
pricing.perStaff: about {{price}} per staff member per month
pricing.noContract: No contract — pay month by month, stop any time.

trial.a: Yes — 14 days with everything included, no card needed. Your first invoice appears a week before the trial ends.

phones.q: My SRs are not good with phones. Will they manage?
phones.a: The app is in Bangla with big buttons and only the steps they need: pick shop, add cartons, save. We show your team how to use it.

internet.q: What if there is no internet in the market?
internet.a: The app keeps orders, deliveries and payments on the phone and sends them when the network is back. Pulling the screen down sends them right away.

price.a: One missed order, one wrong delivery or one day of cash not handed in usually costs more than a month of Onukrom. You see every taka, every day.

import.q: We already have hundreds of shops. Do we type them all?
import.a: No. Import your shop list in one go, then assign the shops to routes.

data.q: Is my data safe and private?
data.a: Every company only ever sees its own shops, orders, prices and staff. You decide who in your team sees what with roles and permissions.

help.a: We do — on the demo call and afterwards from Help & support inside the panel, in Bangla or English.

final.title: Stop guessing. Start knowing — this week.
final.text: Book a free demo today; your team can take orders from the app tomorrow.

footer.about: Order, delivery and collection software for distributors in Bangladesh.
